$comment: Fleet registry. DATA, not code (R5/R15): the fleet script holds no service name, no id, no host and no STORE name. Ids come from the Render dashboard; `live: true` means real customer traffic. Placeholders carry a null id until the sandbox project is provisioned. `protection` is the R1/R3 guard as data: any service whose name starts with `prefix` refuses deploy/rollback unless --i-typed-the-store-name=<store> is passed, matched case-sensitively.
